title: Release Identity Sequence
description: A reference-led rollout sequence that locks one invented musician, one palette, and one analog-neon symbol system across album, single, EP, and deluxe cover moments.
creative_direction: The first image establishes a music-industry hero cover with an invented performer, circular light halo, and wet-night palette. The next three covers must preserve the same face structure, wardrobe silhouette, ring motif, and cinematic release grammar while changing the launch mood.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-midnight-transmitter first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-single-after-rain, 03-ep-strobe-platform, 04-deluxe-dawn-vinyl. Queue may run 02-single-after-rain, 03-ep-strobe-platform, 04-deluxe-dawn-vinyl concurrently after 01-reference-midnight-transmitter is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
